race.title: Cuban Pete Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MY BOBBY'S LASS had too much speed for her rivals when making it third time lucky over fences at Bangor last month and with further improvement on the cards, Mel Rowley's mare is fancied to shrug off a 9 lb rise and follow up. Law of Supply has found one too strong on his last 3 starts and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Doctor Midas taken to fill out third. MY BOBBY'S LASS LAW OF SUPPLY (IRE) DOCTOR MIDAS (FR)
race.bettingForecast: My Bobby's Lass (1/1), Law Of Supply (2/1), Doctor Midas (6/1), Edgewell (12/1), Minella Blueway (20/1)
